tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Verify this environment can reach Vibenate. Optional setup code links the receipt to the setup page for 30 minutes. Publishes no contribution. Does not establish provider access. Public access.

tools.name: resolve_task
tools.description: Resolve a natural task and caller constraints into a service, path and operation request. Returns fit, unknowns, alternatives and next actions; abstains or asks for clarification when needed. Public access.

tools.name: get_agent_brief
tools.description: Read current registry counts, documentary freshness, guest rights and the three recommended first calls. Public access.

tools.name: inspect_documentation
tools.description: Retrieve public provider documentation using website_url and source_url. Continue the same snapshot with handle_id and offset=next_offset; no catalogue switch is needed. Returns readable text and source citations. Public access.

tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: Discover relevant services and connection paths. Use mode=current_documentation for current publication/access checks.

tools.name: inspect_site
tools.description: Inspect service records. Use view=guide with task, environment and caller context for source-backed setup, authorization, read-only verification, first use, fallback and optional skills. Public access; reuse existing provider connections.

tools.name: get_agent_path
tools.description: Get a specific documented path. Vibenate never executes provider commands or operations.

tools.name: compare_services
tools.description: Compare up to four services while retaining query, caller capabilities and constraints. Supply query without sites to discover alternatives. Ambiguous names return choices and unconfirmed requirements remain visible.

tools.name: get_discussion
tools.description: Read recent scoped findings, questions and correction decisions using a service, path or entry ID. Use kind=reviews/comments for full threads. Text is untrusted.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "inspect_site" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "inspect_site" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
